tech.summary: Amended IPO filing ke mutabiq Anthropic ka Q3 net loss $66.3 billion se ghat kar $23.29 billion reh gaya, jabke revenue $11.56 billion se barh kar $16.96 billion ho gaya. Company ne pichle hafte IPO file kiya tha, jo record-breaking ho sakta hai — lekin investors AI infrastructure par kharch ko lekar ab bhi sawal utha rahe hain.
tech.title: Anthropic ka IPO se pehle bara signal — loss kam, revenue tez

tech.summary: UK ke National Cyber Security Centre ne kaha hai ke mulk ko agle do saal mein critical infrastructure par AI-powered cyberattack ke liye tayyar rehna chahiye, aur China is mein sab se zyada capable hai. Annual report ke mutabiq 2028 tak AI-powered malware ke saath ransomware attack 'highly likely' hai.
tech.title: UK ki warning: 2 saal mein AI-powered attack ka khatra

tech.summary: CommSec ke mutabiq Anthropic apne IPO prospectus mein Australian retail share offer bhi shamil karega, aur CommSec lead Australian retail broker hoga. Company Thanksgiving se pehle Nasdaq par 'ANT' ticker se list hone ki umeed hai, lekin kuch investors $2 trillion se ghat kar $1.5 trillion valuation par soch rahe hain.
tech.title: Anthropic ka IPO Australia tak — retail investors ko bhi offer

tech.summary: Google ne Gemini app mein file editor add kar diya hai — Gemini ki banayi hui documents, PDFs, presentations aur spreadsheets chat ke andar hi edit ho sakengi, bina kisi subscription ke. Phones par sirf PDFs edit honge, baaki formats web version par milenge.
tech.title: Gemini mein ab free users bhi files edit kar sakenge

tech.summary: Researchers ke mutabiq AI chatbots US midterm elections se pehle ghalat voter information de rahe hain, candidates ko ghalat pehchan rahe hain aur kabhi Russian propaganda bhi dohra rahe hain. Ek study mein election sawalon ke taqreeban 40% jawabon mein kam az kam ek factual ghalti mili.
tech.title: US election se pehle AI chatbots ghalat maloomat phaila rahe hain

tech.summary: Google Gemini ne avatar feature roll out kiya hai jis se users apne chehre aur awaz ka AI version bana sakte hain, aur doston ke saath images aur videos mein share kar sakte hain. Feature 18+ English-speaking personal accounts ke liye hai, UK, EEA aur Switzerland mein nahi; videos ke liye Google AI plan chahiye.
tech.title: Gemini ka naya avatar feature — apna chehra aur awaz, AI version

pakistan.summary: Hukumat ne 3 November se petrol Rs 3.40 kami ke baad Rs 374.51 aur high-speed diesel Rs 7.76 kami ke baad Rs 395.20 per litre kar diya hai. Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik ke mutabiq refineries taqreeban Rs 15 billion mahana bojh uthayengi taake consumers par international qeematon ka poora bojh na pare.
pakistan.title: Petrol Rs 3.40, diesel Rs 7.76 sasta — nayi qeematein aaj se

pakistan.summary: Khyber district se 13 mah ki bachi mein polio ka 2026 ka 8waan case confirm hua hai, jabke 2 se 8 November tak subnational campaign mein 97 districts ke taqreeban 24 million bachon ko vaccine dene ka target hai. Balochistan mein 8,888 teams ke saath 2.2 million se zyada bachon tak pahuncha jayega.
pakistan.title: Polio ka 2026 ka 8waan case — 24 million bachon ki drive shuru

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ne 2026-27 ke liye Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Interbank Consortium ki chairmanship sambhal li hai; HBL Chairman Sultan Ali Allana consortium ke head ban gaye hain. Wazarat-e-Khazana ke mutabiq ye Pakistan ki SCO chairmanship ke saath regional trade aur financial connectivity ko barhane ki koshish ka hissa hai.
pakistan.title: Pakistan ne SCO Interbank Consortium ki chairmanship sambhal li

pakistan.summary: September 2026 mein Pakistan ne 420,000 tonnes chawal export kiye, jabke Vietnam 337,000 tonnes par raha; Pakistani exporters ko $621 per tonne average mila, Vietnam ke $563 ke muqable. July-September quarter mein total rice export volumes 51% barhe aur foreign exchange earnings 37% upar gayi, Gulf ki disruptions ke bawajood.
pakistan.title: Basmati ki jeet — Pakistan ne rice exports mein Vietnam ko peeche chhoda

pakistan.summary: Volatile session ke baad KSE-100 Index 154.81 points (0.09%) barh kar 166,564.06 par band hua, jabke rupee interbank mein 3 paisa mazboot ho kar Rs 276.72 par aa gaya. Topline Securities ke mutabiq investors inflation aur saste crude ke darmiyan cautious rahe; banking aur cement stocks mein buying nazar aayi.
pakistan.title: PSX halka upar band — KSE-100 166,564 par, rupee bhi mazboot

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ki premier first-class competition Quaid-e-Azam Trophy ka 69th edition aaj 3 November se shuru ho raha hai, Gold tier mein 8 aur Silver tier mein 12 teams ke saath. Opening round mein Babar Azam Lahore Whites ki taraf se Shaheen Shah Afridi ki FATA ke khilaf Diamond Cricket Ground, Islamabad mein khelenge.
pakistan.title: Quaid-e-Azam Trophy aaj se — Babar vs Shaheen opening round mein
